title: Synthetic demo: 4D, class change and time shift
attribution: Synthetic data generated by seismic_art (no real survey)
bulk_note: bulk shift +4 ms: the median lag of the monitor against the base on the control horizon over 15000 picks (p10 +3.6, p90 +4.4 ms); removed before anything else was measured, because a constant offset between two processings (first-sample convention, statics, datum, velocity model) is not a change in the earth

reference.label: edge of the swept patch (synthetic truth)

notes: amplitudes are relative; compare within this file only

classes: k-means on the shape-normalised base windows, the monitor assigned to the nearest base class after its time shift is removed (a class change is a change of shape); the number of classes is a judgement
shift: cross-correlation lag of the monitor against the base, refined between samples, after the declared bulk shift; positive = later in the monitor; NRMS is measured before the shift is removed
at the repeatability of two surveys some change is noise: read every reservoir number against the control horizon

the monitor differs from the base inside one round patch: thin-bed reflections weakened by 40% and every boundary below the top 3 ms earlier (the top itself does not move); new noise everywhere; the whole cube delayed by one sample as a bookkeeping offset
picks = the true horizons with simulated interpreter errors; picks further than 12 ms from their neighbours' median are excluded
names_note: surface names are the synthetic model's boundaries, illustrative only; no real formation is meant
